description: This PHP file defines the ViewConfig class, which extends SugarView, responsible for rendering the configuration interface for the EmailMan module within SuiteCRM. It includes methods for module title generation, access control, and the main display logic to populate the configuration template with current settings, user information, and security options.

classes.name: ViewConfig
classes.description: A class extending SugarView to manage the display of the EmailMan module configuration page in SuiteCRM, including access control, retrieving settings, assigning variables to the template, and rendering the configuration interface.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates the module title parameters, including a hyperlink to the administration module.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Performs an access control check to ensure the current user has administrative privileges before viewing.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to populate the template variables with current settings and user data, and render the configuration template for EmailMan.
